description: Source code for a serializer class that converts between Pipecat frames and the Vonage WebSocket protocol, handling audio and control messages.

classes.name: VonageFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Vonage Video API Audio Connector WebSocket protocol, converting Pipecat frames to/from WebSocket messages.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline settings based on StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into WebSocket messages or binary data for Vonage.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts WebSocket messages from Vonage into Pipecat frames.
